senses.gloss: to look at, reflect; to become wise. Targ. Prov. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 1:3">Targ. Is. I, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 3:6">Targ. O. Ex. III, 6</cite> (Y. <he>מִסְתְּכֵי</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite>, end [read:] … <he>מִסְתַּכְּלִין אתון ואנא מְסְתַּכֵּל בניביה של אותה דובה</he> you look at that which is on her back, but I look at that bear’s tusks; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145">Yalk. ib. 145</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 113b">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>אינהי מִסְתַּכְּלָן בהו ואינהו … לאִסְתַּכּוּלֵי בהו</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) they looked at them (the shoemakers), but the latter did not lift up their eyes to look at them. Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ top <he>תלא עינוי מִסְתַּכְּלָא</he> he lifted up his eyes in order to observe; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ top <he>מִסְתַּכְּלָה</he>; a. fr.
